definitions: To give a particular form or a definite form to something.
To influence the development of something; to determine the nature of something.
To take on a particular form or appearance.
To develop in a particular way or into a particular form.
examples: She shaped the clay into a small bowl.
His experiences shaped his view of the world.
The clouds began to shape like animals.
The project is shaping up well.
pastTenses: shaped (past simple), shaped (present perfect), shaped (past perfect)
